info.name: code-server Layer
info.summary: Open your code and text files from Nextcloud in code-server, in a new tab
info.description:
code-server Layer opens the files of a folder of yours in code-server, the editor that runs on a server and in the browser. It is meant for a code-server that works on a copy of that folder, kept in sync with Nextcloud.
**Status:** early. Files offers "Open in code-server" for common text and programming formats (PowerShell, shell, Python, web, JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, INI, logs, Markdown, C and C#, Java, Go, Rust, SQL, Terraform, Dockerfile and more), and opens them on a click where no other app does, or for all of them as the default app. "+ New" entries create a file in code-server. Code formats Nextcloud does not know get its code icon. Opening warns when the file changed in Nextcloud moments ago or is open in Nextcloud Text. English and German.
Needs a code-server reachable by the browser and a sync between Nextcloud and its working copy. Not affiliated with Coder or Microsoft. Source code and documentation: https://github.com/hozwei/nextcloud-codeserver-layer
info.author: The nextcloud-codeserver-layer contributors
